response.text: {"verdict": "covered", "clause_ids": ["A7.1", "A13.2"], "rationale": "The claim involves the theft of a winter coat from a parked car, which was reported to the police. Clause A7.1 covers theft of luggage, and the police report (A13.2) was provided as required. Clause A7.5 does not apply because the theft occurred in a vehicle, which is explicitly excluded, but this exclusion does not override the coverage for theft under A7.1 when a police report is provided. The item is covered under the luggage section."}
